title: SEC0: Silent error discard in group chat fanout enqueue
description:
In kith-chat/src/message.rs process_create (lines 370-380):

The group chat fanout loop discards all enqueue() errors via 'let _ = guard.outbox().enqueue(...)'. If an outbox enqueue fails (e.g., due to database constraint violation), the error is silently ignored.

While unlikely in Phase 1 (single-writer), silent errors mask bugs and make debugging harder. If a constraint violation or database error occurs, the message will not be enqueued to all participants, but the sender receives no error indication.

Fix: At minimum, log failures to stderr. Better: track and report failures in the response or log them appropriately.
